listing.summary: The alpha reaches boot, title, intro, opening gameplay, audio and saving. Start-to-finish checks are incomplete. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA multi-disc images. Source generation needs SLUS006.64 and your matching SCPH1001 BIOS; release packages use OpenBIOS by default.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the release package or generate code and compile from source. Keep your disc available during play.
